prompt: A cinematic film still captures the chaotic energy of a busy restaurant kitchen. On the far left, a chef with a tall white hat stands rigidly, holding a gleaming silver ladle above a steaming pot. Next to him, a sous chef in a stained apron points urgently at a stack of dirty plates piled high on the counter. In the center, a line cook with tattoos on his forearms flips a sizzling burger patty in a black skillet while looking at the expeditor. The expeditor, a woman with sharp glasses and a clipboard, stands beside the pass, checking orders with intense focus. To her right, a dishwasher with wet hair scrubs a large metal tray under running water. Behind them, a waiter in a crisp white shirt rushes through the swinging doors, balancing three full plates on one arm. Near the back wall, a health inspector in a gray suit observes the scene with a critical eye, standing next to a fire extinguisher mounted on the tiled wall. A small brown cat sits calmly on top of a refrigerator in the background, watching the chaos below. On the floor near the center, a dropped wooden spoon lies forgotten amidst scattered flour. Above the stove, a hanging rack holds several copper pots that sway slightly from the movement. There is no digital clock visible on the walls. There is no window showing the outside world. The chef with the tall white hat is positioned on the left. The line cook with tattoos is located in the center. The dishwasher with wet hair is on the right side of the frame.
